name: MCP List Tools
description: List tools available on configured MCP servers.

function.name: mcp_list_tools
function.description: List the tools exposed by external MCP servers configured on this platform (e.g. 'claude-code'). Returns each tool's name, description and JSON input schema. Call this before mcp_call to discover valid tool names and their expected arguments. Requires the MCP Client plugin to be enabled.

server.description: Name of a configured MCP server (e.g. 'claude-code'). Omit to list tools from all configured servers.
